question: Should this PR's first-party Control UI math rendering path be accepted as a default behavior, narrowed to explicit or opt-in syntax, or deferred in favor of another open candidate implementation?
rationale: The feature has clear user demand, but accepting it changes untrusted chat rendering and introduces same-origin third-party JavaScript, so automation cannot choose the permanent syntax, dependency, and vendoring policy safely.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow syntax
options.body: Require a package/build-provenance path and disable single-dollar parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept it as an opt-in/default behavior.

options.title: Approve vendored MathJax
options.body: Accept the self-hosted bundle only with explicit source, license, version, update, and review provenance documented in the PR.

options.title: Defer to another candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the existing KaTeX candidate path or a different markdown-layer design.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow syntax
recommendation.body: Require a package/build-provenance path and disable single-dollar parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept it as an opt-in/default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent history on the Control UI markdown/config surface and Gateway security/CSP paths that decide both the product behavior and security boundary here.
